# IndiaDostiChat

IndiaDostiChat is a free anonymous India chat room where users can connect with friends online using just a nickname.

## Main Pages
- Homepage: https://www.indiadostichat.com/
- Live Chat: https://www.indiadostichat.com/chat/
- Chat Rules: https://www.indiadostichat.com/rules/
- Community Blog: https://www.indiadostichat.com/blog/
- Games: https://www.indiadostichat.com/games/
- Donate: https://www.indiadostichat.com/donate/
